import re

def parse_color(text):
    # Regular expression to match the valid hex color formats
    pattern = r'^#([A-Fa-f0-9]{6}|[A-Fa-f0-9]{3})$'
    
    if not re.match(pattern, text):
        raise ValueError("Invalid hex color format")
    
    # Remove the '#' character
    hex_color = text[1:]
    
    # If the hex color is 3 digits, double each digit
    if len(hex_color) == 3:
        hex_color = ''.join([char * 2 for char in hex_color])
    
    # Convert the hex color to integers
    r = int(hex_color[0:2], 16)
    g = int(hex_color[2:4], 16)
    b = int(hex_color[4:6], 16)
    
    return (r, g, b)

def slugify(text):
    # Convert the input text to lowercase
    text = text.lower()
    # Replace all non-alphanumeric characters with '-' using a regular expression
    import re
    text = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', text)
    # Strip leading and trailing '-' characters from the result
    text = text.strip('-')
    # Return the slugified string
    return text
